content: Example services use the vanilla org.openapi.generator plugin with generatorName=spring, interfaceOnly=true, useSpringBoot3=true, useTags=true, skipDefaultInterface=true. The spec generates *Api interfaces + DTO models; we write the @RestController impls. Generated sources go to build/generated and are wired into the main source set; compileJava dependsOn openApiGenerate. Keep spec <-> controllers <-> DTOs in sync.

name: Hierarchical REST paths mirror the resource tree
description: Nest URLs to reflect the resource hierarchy: /catalogs/{id}/categories/{id}/products/{id}. Validate each ancestor exists and that the child belongs to it (findByIdAndParentId) so cross-parent access returns 404, not someone else's data. This nesting is also what the ABAC hierarchical-authorization pattern keys off.

content: Map JPA column types to match the entity exactly, validated against REAL Postgres. char(3) becomes bpchar and fails Hibernate ddl-auto=validate against a String field expecting varchar — use varchar(n). timestamptz needs @TimeZoneStorage(NATIVE) on OffsetDateTime. Run schema validation under Testcontainers (real Postgres), never H2, so these mismatches surface in the build.
